subject: Lumenix consumption roadmap + $/1M targets (hosted API) — post-call recap
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@lumenix.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Lumenix consumption roadmap + $/1M targets (hosted API) — post-call recap

Alex — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side.

Call summary (TL;DR):
- Expected monthly token volume (you indicated): 150M–350M, nominal ~250M tokens/month.
- Peak concurrency: you called out short flash peaks up to ~320 TPS (99th spike window), stable traffic baseline nearer 120–180 TPS.
- Budget target: you mentioned preference for ~$20–$25 / 1M tokens depending on SLOs and term.

What I captured as the priority asks from Lumenix:
1) Validate a hosted pricing path that supports: a monthly commit band, burst headroom for flash TPS, and a 99th percentile latency SLO for user facing flows.
2) Procurement & compliance checklist (SOC2, data retention, contracts).
3) A small pilot to validate inference latency and cost at scale before a longer commitment.

Immediate next steps (from Redwood):
- Attached: your usage snapshot you shared on the call (Lumenix_Monthly_Usage_Snapshot.csv) — we used it to sketch baseline economics.
- I’m looping Marissa (sales lead) and Karthik (pricing ops) to draft 2 pricing options: 
  A) Short-term pilot + month-to-month hosted pricing with conservative $/1M and burst allowance.
  B) 12-month committed slab with stepped discounts tied to monthly token volume.
- Please confirm procurement contact (you mentioned Anita Rao) and any specific contractual requirements (PO cadence, invoicing).

Questions for you before we send a formal pricing note:
- Is the 150M–350M window the right working range for July–Sept, or is July an outlier?
- Can you share the expected percentage of traffic that requires the 99th <200ms objective vs. background async work?

Proposed cadence: we’ll send the pricing note and a pilot proposal by EOD tomorrow (Wed). If that works, suggest we book a short 30-min technical validation session (Karthik + infra) next week to scope the pilot success criteria.

Appreciate your time — talk soon.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Cc: Anita Rao <anita@lumenix.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 16:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lumenix consumption roadmap + $/1M targets (hosted API) — post-call recap

Thanks Vanessa — this looks right. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Our internal modeling heavy-traffic months trend toward ~275M tokens/month (so mid of your range).
- The 320 TPS spikes are real during peak campaign launches; those spikes last ~6–10 minutes and are highly bursty. Sustained baseline is ~140 TPS.
- For latency: user-facing inference must target 99th <200ms on our preferred flows (chat UI + real-time suggestions). Background batch/async jobs can tolerate higher latencies and lower priority. Roughly 70% of tokens are user-interactive.

Procurement: Anita is procurement lead (procurement@lumenix.ai). They will need: SOC2, standard DPA, and an invoice sample. I’ve cc’d Anita.

Budget: Our FP&A target is roughly $20 / 1M if we can get a 12-month commitment with some predictability on burst allowance. For a short pilot we’re open to paying a market rate to validate latency.

Next steps: Confirming Anita is the right procurement contact; please send your pilot proposal + pricing sheet and we’ll route internally.

—Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Product, Lumenix
alex@lumenix.ai

Marissa / Karthik — looping you both in to position pricing and next steps after Alex’s note. Forwarded the thread below for context.

My read:
- Committed-band economics will be required to hit Lumenix’s $20 target. They’re willing to commit to a 12-month term for predictability, contingent on burst headroom and a clean SLO for the interactive flows.
- Pilot should be lightweight (2 weeks) and validate 99th latency <200ms under representative load.

Suggested starter pricing (for discussion):
- Option 1 — Pilot & month-to-month:
  * 2-week pilot: 50M tokens free (validate latency + functional checks)
  * Post-pilot month-to-month: $29 / 1M tokens baseline, burst credits at +30% TPS allowed; invoiced monthly.
- Option 2 — 12-month committed slab (preferred to match $20 target):
  * Commit 250M tokens/month minimum for 12 months: $22 / 1M tokens.
  * Commit 500M+/month: $19 / 1M tokens.
  * Burst policy: automatic buffer for short spikes up to 40% of committed TPS before throttling; additional burst invoiced at blended overtime rate.

Notes and trade-offs to surface to the customer:
- The $20 / 1M they requested is feasible but requires a firm committed slab + payment terms (quarterly/annual).
- If they need guaranteed 99th latency SLO at the lower price tier we should attach an SLA credit schedule and involve infra for capacity reservations (Dedicated or reserved pools).

Attachments: Redwood_Hosted_Pricing_Tiers_v2.pdf (pricing sheet w/ burst and SLA options).

Marissa — can you own the commercial narrative and present these two options (and a pilot agreement) to Alex & Anita today? If you want me on the call with infra, I’m available tomorrow morning.

Thanks — Vanessa

Hi Alex / Anita — thanks for the quick replies and for confirming Anita as procurement.

We’d like to propose a pragmatic pilot + commercial path so you can validate latency and unit economics before a longer commit: 
Pilot proposal (recommended):
- Duration: 14 days
- Tokens: 50M tokens allocated to the pilot environment; metered and instrumented.
- Cost: Pilot tokens provided complimentary; if Lumenix elects to consume >50M during the pilot we’ll invoice overage at $29 / 1M pro-rated.
- Success criteria: 99th latency <200ms for interactive flows across three representative traffic patterns; no visible degradation at observed peak bursts (up to 320 TPS simulated).

Commercial proposal (post-pilot):
- Month-to-month option: $29 / 1M tokens (no long-term commitment). Includes 30% automatic burst buffer.
- 12-month committed option (preferred): tiered pricing tied to committed monthly tokens:
   * 250M–499M: $22 / 1M
   * 500M–999M: $19 / 1M
   * 1B+: bespoke pricing and capacity reservation (please request quote)
- Billing: Net 30 by default; discounts available for quarterly/annual prepayment.

Next steps we suggest this week:
1) Procurement (Anita) — share any contracting templates and invoice sample so we can prep DocuSign and invoicing fields.
2) Tech sync — schedule 30-min infra session next week to agree on pilot test harness and KPIs (I’ll invite Karthik).
3) Pilot kickoff — once procurement and test plan are agreed, we’ll provision pilot environment.

I’ll draft a brief pilot statement of work and send for signature; Vanessa — if you can share any final notes from the initial call I’ll fold them in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
